**A stroke no longer stops Massif when something else changes the map under it.** Smoothing in 3D Sculpt for a while could end on "History::begin was not called": while a stroke was held, something else closed its step to undo (an undo, a selection made with Esc, ⌘A or ⌘D, a task's or the terrain graph's result put in place), and the stroke's next dab had no step to record into. A stroke now notices and records the rest of itself as a step of its own, tasks finishing during a stroke wait for it to end, and an edit with no step open is recorded in a new one rather than stopping the app. When a frame does stop on an error, the stroke it cut short is taken back, in the map and in the copy Massif keeps of it, so that neither holds half a stroke.
